messages.content: do something so i can check the progress states and see the icons in action

This is exactly what feeds the Progress Tree page's status icons (done / in-progress / not-started / roadmap, each module with a checklist). The server's already running on port 4317.

Open **http://localhost:4317/tree.html** in your browser — that's the Progress Tree view where each of the 46 modules shows its status icon (gear for Casino Settings, etc.) plus the done/partial/todo checklist states. The Kanban board (Now/Next/Later/Done, from `data/progress.json`) is on the main app shell at **http://localhost:4317/**.

Want me to change a module's status or checklist item first so you can watch the icon actually flip, or are you just going to click through it live?
